author: Unreal Engine
description:
Remmick's fate in Sinners was the subject of debate on set, in regards to how it would be set up, blocked and framed. That was until an iPhone photo and a bold idea helped clarify the vision, and from there, the visuals were fleshed out.

You can learn more about visualization and VFX on the Oscar Award winning film in our Fireside Chat, here: https://youtu.be/lUKR7lZoFYI
title: Remmick's fate in Sinners was the subject of debate on set
